title: ObjectDef
description: One kind of man-made object, built by a procedural generator where the region's vectors place it (buildings, power lines, fences, log piles). Lives in defs/objects/<name>.json.

title.description: English name, with the Swedish name in brackets.

params.description: Shape parameters read by the generator, in metres and degrees. A [min, max] pair is drawn anew for every object.

colors.description: Named palettes; each object picks one colour from each palette. Repeat a colour to make it more common.

range.description: Drawn up to this many metres from the camera.

collider.description: True when vehicles can hit it.
